issues.where: Lower-middle moon and cast shadow (pair-02-b crop A)
issues.what: The cast shadow has a harder edge and a more sharply defined far tip than the reference, and the moon loses some of its red-brown shading at the bottom.
issues.fix: Restore a slightly wider penumbra toward the tip and recover the warm underside shading without moving the moon.

issues.where: Right-hand terminator and dark disk (pair-02-b crops C, E, G and I)
issues.what: A few isolated curls and thin blue streaks remain legible too far into the night side; the reference rolls into a more continuous dark mass.
issues.fix: Suppress the isolated streaks and smooth the cloud-detail falloff into the deep black.

issues.where: Lit left limb, especially upper-left (pair-02-b crops B and D)
issues.what: The atmospheric bloom spreads farther into the stars and looks slightly grayer than the tighter warm halo in the reference.
issues.fix: Pull in the outer bloom and keep the edge light a soft warm white.

issues.where: Northern bands and central cloud belts (pair-02-b crops A, B and I)
issues.what: The finest pale and blue-gray cloud filaments have a little less definition against the ochre belts.
issues.fix: Recover fine local contrast in the cloud striations without changing the belt layout or overall exposure.

issues.where: Sky, particularly the sparse left field and bright galactic band to the right (pair-02-b crops B through H)
issues.what: Many stars look brighter and rounder, while the fine dusty texture in the galactic band reads a little softer.
issues.fix: Reduce star bloom and recover the distinction between crisp pinpoints and diffuse galactic dust.

issues.where: Sky above the diagonal horizon (pair-04-b crops C and I)
issues.what: The brightest stars are more swollen and conspicuous than the reference's finer points, making the upper-right sky look busier.
issues.fix: Scale back point-source bloom and brightness while keeping the faint galactic structure in place.

issues.where: Storm rim, sunlit shoulders and lower-left foreground curls (pair-04-b crops A, B, D, F, G and H)
issues.what: The vortex and cloud banks line up, but some of the thinnest lit edges and dark grooves blend together more than in the reference, reducing the sense of relief.
issues.fix: Restore selective microcontrast along the amber ridges and foreground folds without sharpening the shadow floor.

issues.where: Lower-right blue-lit cloud pockets (pair-04-b crop E)
issues.what: The blue glow is slightly more diffuse around its brightest cores, with less separation between the narrow illuminated filaments and surrounding black folds.
issues.fix: Tighten the blue bloom around the cores and recover the fine filament edges.
